![](https://commonwealth-uploads.s3.us-east-2.amazonaws.com/cb29ab97-8473-4267-ac09-296e11a8c3dd.1656334577497)

**Art Rate Campus is a permanent place for managing campaigns and holding art-related classes, and through this camp we want to attract artists and manage programs and audiences interactively through Discord.**

**In this letter, while appreciating the efforts of all those involved in the construction and commissioning of the growth center and the shared work space, and thanking the staff of the Khaneh Sarhang, especially the Pourghasemi family, we announce that the space is identified as Art Rate Campus. And it’s ready to provide services to all applicants In Iran, Tehran.**

**Location: **
[https://goo.gl/maps/XwKm8j7m7qVJ2Xwh7](https://goo.gl/maps/XwKm8j7m7qVJ2Xwh7)
**Instagram:**
[https://www.instagram.com/artratecampus](https://www.instagram.com/artratecampus)

Art Rate Campus has been created and operated in order to achieve the goal of physical support for the Art Rate project and with the approach of creating an interactive work environment and shared work space for artists and professionals in related fields. In addition to providing workspace services, mentoring and project management services, as well as physical support for holding special events and meetings.
